messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — PR #874 adds a new migration guide page. Need a docs preview and one reviewer during tomorrow's merge slot.
devon: Can do. Any failing checks locally?
maria: Local mkdocs build passes, but Netlify preview is showing 404 for internal anchors (linkcheck failing). Suspect the anchor ids changed after a markdown extension update.
sam: I ran linkcheck locally with `mkdocs build && mkdocs serve` — didn't catch it. Netlify sets EXTRA_MARKDOWN_EXT=1 in preview env; local doesn't.
maria: Repro steps I used in Docker:
```bash
docker run --rm -v $PWD:/docs -w /docs python:3.11 bash -c "pip install mkdocs mkdocs-material && mkdocs build"
```
devon: Try adding `mkdocs build --strict` — linkcheck will error if anchors mismatch.
julie: tagging @devon — I can review but only in the afternoon. Is the merge window 09:00 PT tomorrow?
maria: It's 09:30 PT. If CI finishes before 09:15 we'll merge. Otherwise hold to next slot.
docs-ci: Netlify preview deployed: https://deploy-preview-874--redwood-docs.netlify.app :white_check_mark:
sam: Preview link loads but anchor jump doesn't work. The page has `id="migration_guide_v2"` while internal link points to `#migration-guide-v2`.
devon: That explains it. Markdown extension changed underscore handling between versions.
maria: Quick fix: change the anchor in the link to match. I pushed 874.1 with a one-line patch.
deploy-bot: Netlify preview redeployed: https://deploy-preview-874-1--redwood-docs.netlify.app :rocket:
julie: Looked good. Local check instructions for reviewers:
- `git fetch && git checkout pr/874`
- `pip install -r docs/requirements.txt`
- `mkdocs serve -a 0.0.0.0:8000`
- open http://localhost:8000 and use browser devtools to inspect anchor ids
devon: also add this for folks behind corp proxy: `mkdocs serve --dev-addr=0.0.0.0:8000` in docker and forward port 8000
sam: FYI if you use Vercel previews you can run `npx serve ./site` after `mkdocs build` to mimic static hosting headers.
maria: Thanks all — I'll merge tomorrow at 09:30 PT if CI green. Please leave :thumbsup: on the PR if you approve.
julie: :thumbsup:
devon: :thumbsup:
docs-ci: CI passed for 874.1 — linkcheck ok.
